body:
Review read of head `9784f8fa3` (read-only Opus agent that did not write the change, nothing built). The review comment with the marker follows after the independent run.

**Result of the read: no blocker.**

- **The normal case does not change.** A run end and the next start are never above the model top. So with a retract height at or above the model top, `hop.max(z0).max(cur.z)` is the old `hop.max(z0)`, and the same three moves are written. Below the model top the output changes only where `straight_ok` refuses the move across, and that function refuses only a real intrusion. So the output differs from `main` in three cases only: the retract is below the run end; the old move across cut the model; an input is not finite.
- **The fix.** A boss between two runs is caught: `sups` holds each facet, and the check is an exact distance from the segment to each triangle with the ball radius. The move up from the run end goes up. The plunge to the next start uses the same clear column. A zero-length move is dropped by `PathBuilder::push`.
- **"Model top"** is the highest facet vertex of the part, not of the stock. The `RapidInStock` that stays on the Inside mesa case is correct: with no earlier operation the stock above the base is not cut.
- **Callers.** Each 3D finish pattern that uses `emit_runs` gets the fix (`drape`, `flow`, `morph`, `polar`, `raster`, `shadow`). None sets a low retract on purpose.
- **Rules.** `march.rs` goes from 390 to 397 lines. Eight tests are new, none is removed. No golden moved. The sentence in `docs/decisions/3362-pass-start-finish3d.md` is corrected.

**One item to correct before the merge (small):** the two app tests in `crates/app/tests/finish3d_hop_height.rs` write the same file (`camcraft-3627-<pid>/step_pocket.stl`) and can run at the same time. One test can read the file while the other writes it. Give each test its own file name or directory. A test that fails at random makes `main` red.

Follow-ups: #3633 (`P3`: the hop between two waterline rings of one level is not checked across) and #3634 (`P7`: cost of the model top scan; the shank under an overhang).

Addressed: the two tests in `crates/app/tests/finish3d_hop_height.rs` now write their fixture to separate directories (`camcraft-3627-<pid>-<test tag>`). Nothing else changed. Head b12d9dee39d4b283cc73205625204ee2799e40c3. `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test finish3d_hop_height -j 6` ran three times: 2 passed each time. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test finish3d_hop_height -j 6 -- -D warnings`: clean.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b12d9dee39d4b283cc73205625204ee2799e40c3 -->
**Review of head `b12d9dee3`: clean. No blocker.** The read of `9784f8fa3` is in the comment above (a read-only Opus agent that did not write the change). The delta to this head is one test file: each of the two app tests has its own fixture directory (the coordinator read the 12-line diff).

**Independent runs** (a gate-runner that did not write the change; main `1e7800a9e` is an ancestor of the head):
- On `9784f8fa3`: each motion test binary compiles; motion lib 551, `finish3d_hop_height` 3, `finish3d_pass_start` 3, `finish3d` 55, `finish3d_gaplink` 7, `finish3d_holes` 5, `finish3d_land` 7, `finish3d_overhang_and_chord` 3, `scallop_ceiling` 4, `multiaxis` 7, `machining3d` 23, `pocket3d_pass_start` 2; app lib 300 and 19 named app binaries (with `golden_cl`, `conformance`, `verify`, `operations`, `mcp`, `docs_troubleshooting`, the three `example_catalog` suites, `first_part_programs`); ui lib 1494; 0 failed. clippy with `-D warnings` on motion, app lib and ui: clean. No golden moved.
- On this head: app `finish3d_hop_height` 5 runs and 2 runs with 8 test threads, 2 passed each; its clippy clean; motion `finish3d_hop_height` 3; motion lib `hop` tests 9.

**What changes for a user:** with a retract height below the end of a run, the tool no longer moves down into the part at the hop. With a retract height at or above the top of the part, the moves are the same as before.

Not run: the heavy lanes (`P3`: none is due). Follow-ups: #3633, #3634.
